FIFA WORLD CUP 2026 MARKET COHERENCE ANALYSIS

- Netherlands: ~4-6%
- Italy: ~3-5%

   If we could buy YES on ALL teams, do the probabilities sum to exactly 100% (no arb) or >100% (overround/book margin) or <100% (guaranteed arb)?
   - On prediction markets like Polymarket, the platform takes NO vig/margin

   - But across DIFFERENT binary markets (France YES vs England YES), there's no mathematical constraint unless it's a negRisk pool

   - In negRisk: the sum of all YES outcomes must equal exactly 100% of the payout

   If total > 100%, buying all NO is +EV. If total = 100%, no edge on aggregate.

   - France at 16.7%: If sportsbooks say 20%, this is a 20% underpricing. BUY YES France.

   - USA at 1.1%: Host country. Historical host advantage is real (~7% boost). Is 1.1% too low?
